plan: A dragon mage who grows in power over the game and can fly over walls.
aSurveiller: His R (Falling Star). He drops a star that stuns: don't stay grouped in the marked area.
contrer: Poke him early: he needs time to become strong.
Interrupt his breath (Q) with crowd control: he has to channel it.
Get out of his black hole (E) fast: it pulls you to the centre.
forces: Power that grows over the game.

sorts.P: Gains stardust that upgrades his spells.
sorts.Q: Continuous breath that damages the first one hit.
sorts.E: Black hole that pulls to the centre.

momentFort: Weak early, stronger and stronger in the late game.
